name: Opengist
description: Pastebin for code snippets, powered by Git, like GitHub Gist

paths.name: Opengist
paths.description: Your gists (git repositories), the database, the search index, the session key (opengist-secret.key) and logs. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Opengist web app and git over http, published on host as 6815

ports.name: Port 6816
ports.description: Git over SSH, published on host as 6816

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: UID
variables.description: The user that owns the data folder. It is filled in by MOS.

variables.name: GID
variables.description: The group that owns the data folder. It is filled in by MOS.

variables.name: OG_SSH_PORT
variables.description: The port of the built-in SSH server for git clone and push. It must stay the same as the published port (6816), so clone links show the right port.
